goal: Drive AKS RP e2e feature knowledge, runnable test specs, replay execution, evidence diagnosis, and model feedback.
strategy: Ground feature intent in source, API/spec, documentation, design, implementation, and current evidence.
Keep feature-owned specs and compact plans executable and verified through live staging evidence.
Use bounded controllers to declare current work; use the canonical task projection to observe live state.
Feed verified results and durable experience back into the model without mirroring live task lists here.

planning.focus: Preserve the no-new-live verifier and result-drain envelope while bounded spec, compact, and scenario controllers rebuild only current represented work.
successCriteria: Standing controllers remain live, bounded, and converged when their current work is represented.
Every durable wait names an exact typed fact with a registered observer or explicit human return path.
Current task state and counts are read from .state/tasks/tree.json rather than copied into project metadata.
